f10b_rule19_violation.bash_tool_confirmation: ftabs=0 -> pass_indent='\t' (wrong); correct='    ' (4 spaces for space-dominant file)
f10b_rule19_violation.fix: detect_indent(path) before inserting pass; use dominant_char*(depth+1) not always tab

rss_monitoring_note.root_cause: Godot ran 99 seconds but /proc poller only captured data when polling cycle coincided with live process. After process exit, read_proc_stats() returns None (FileNotFoundError). The peak RSS from the final poll before exit is typically low because the process had already started cleanup. Not a contention issue.
rss_monitoring_note.fix: Add wall-time-based periodic poll independent of readline() loop using threading.Thread or select() to ensure /proc is sampled during active gameplay not just during readline() blocking
